verdict.rationale: Galileo's metrics overview documents custom code-based metrics and composite code-based metrics as first-class ways to extend its built-in metrics. Experiments run against metrics of your choice, metrics can be scoped globally or per project, and the free plan includes unlimited custom evals. The evidence is limited to overview-level mentions and does not show how such scorers are written. missing for 10: detailed docs on the code-based scorer authoring interface (function signature, languages, execution environment), worked examples of a custom code scorer running in an experiment, independent or hands-on corroboration.
